name: Lucas Cubes
summary: The induced subgraphs of Q_n on cyclic binary strings with no two consecutive ones, with the standard K1 conventions in dimensions zero and one.
parameters: Integer $n\ge0$; for $n\ge2$ the first and last bits are also forbidden to be simultaneously one.
comments: Equivalently, Lambda_n is the simplex graph of the complement of the n-cycle for n at least three.
